validation_notes: The right side of the chart (mid-Jun to Jul) shows a recovery from ~1580 low to a range roughly 1800-1950, followed by consolidation with fairly flat highs (~1950) and flat lows (~1830-1850). This looks more like a tight horizontal/rectangular consolidation than a converging triangle - the upper and lower boundaries are both roughly flat rather than sloping toward each other. There's no clear diagonal convergence (descending highs meeting rising lows); instead price has been trading sideways in a narrow band for the last few weeks after the sharp bounce off lows. This resembles a flag/range rather than a symmetric triangle apex formation.
